about: Golden cases for the checks (scripts/run-evals.mjs). Each case edits a copy of one real file and says what the check must do. 'control' cases must pass: they prove the check is not simply failing everything. Banned words and key shapes are written as @@PLACEHOLDERS@@ so this file itself passes the copy and security checks.
